domain_restrictions: n is an integer with n greater than 1
m is an integer with 0 less than or equal to m and m less than or equal to n minus 1
t is a real with 0 less than or equal to t and t less than 1
floor is applied to the real number n times t
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For all integers n with n greater than 1, for all integers m with 0 <= m <= n minus 1, and for all real t with 0 <= t and t < 1: the statement 'floor of (n times t) equals m' is logically equivalent to the statement 'm divided by n is less than or equal to t and t is strictly less than (m plus 1) divided by n'.

variables.name: n
variables.role: outer parameter; also determines scaling by n and the allowed range of m

variables.name: m
variables.role: target value of the floor of n*t

variables.name: t
variables.role: input to the floor function after scaling by n

witness_dependencies: no existential witnesses appear; there is no dependence of an existential quantity on universally quantified variables

statement_nl: For every integer n>1, every integer m with 0 <= m <= n-1, and every real t with 0 <= t < 1, one has floor(n*t) = m if and only if m/n <= t < (m+1)/n.
